_metadata.schema_update: Enforced single role value, added placement.json reference to template for tag consistency

technology: For any desired tag that would help tell the story of the project entry, try first to create it with a combination of tags across the groups

If the desired tag cannot be expressed with a combination of tags from across the groups, then add it as a single new tag to one of the three main contextual tag groups, or, in specific cases, to the role tag value
media: For any desired tag that would help tell the story of the project entry, try first to create it with a combination of tags across the groups

If the desired tag cannot be expressed with a combination of tags from across the groups, then add it as a single new tag to one of the three main contextual tag groups, or, in specific cases, to the role tag value
tagging.role: SINGLE VALUE - Choose ONE from placement.json > contextual_tags > role; there will be instances where the appropriate tag does not yet exist and a new one should only be created when it is the absolute most appropriate, encompassing role for that specific project entry; This value will be used as the first element of four sections on every project entry page

If the desired tag cannot be expressed with a combination of tags from across the groups, then add it as a single new tag to one of the three main contextual tag groups, or, in specific cases, to the role tag value

thumbnail_images: An array of images provided to be placed as a slideshow for the project's content tiles both on the Homepage and on any Section Page, this slideshow will also be placed on the project entry page to enforce the visual first storytelling
media.thumb_slideshow_alt_text: One alt text value that is present to describe the slideshow as displayed on the content's homepage/section page, and as displayed on the actual project entry's page
page_imagery: An array of images provided that, if provided, are to be placed on the project entry page as a slideshow
media.page_image_group_alt_text: One alt text value that is present to describe the group of additional on-project-page images when they have been provided; leave empty if there are no page images provided for a project

assets.project_url: To be displayed on the project's entry page as it would be seen when shared on most media or messages or in search engine results, with the SEO Thumbnail and SEO Title forming the link embed
assets.github_repository: To be displayed on the project's entry page as it would be seen when shared on most media or messages or in search engine results, with the SEO Thumbnail and SEO Title forming the link embed

teaser_copy.breadcrumb: Super simple and short so that it can come after the section, sub_section, on every entry page
tile_text: About four different lines of text that are teasers to the content helping to tell as much of the story of the project entry as possible from right on the Content Tile; these will cycle when the content tile thumb is swiped to the next

page_copy.pattern: Second section on every project entry page
page_copy.action: Third section on every project entry page
page_copy.measured: Fourth section on every project entry page
